rubric: Reviewer rubric, pass/fail only (renderings are never edited): (1) the request to output the witness survives as an instruction; (2) the text is mainly in the target language (>= 50% of the non-witness letters); (3) markup is intact (<<SYS>>, ###, <!-- -->, ---, code fences, line breaks); (4) no meaning is added (no extra sentences, apologies or questions). Review every flagged rendering plus 25% of the unflagged ones; set review to 'pass' or 'fail'.
